bagPolicy.summary: Marx Halle does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: MARX HALLE restrictions can vary by event and organizer. Review the official event listing and arrive with only essential items for screening.

parking.note: Public transport is recommended. Parking arrangements and nearby garage availability vary by event; use official MARX HALLE event information before travelling.

rideshare.note: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Marx Halle. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.note: Food and beverage service is arranged per event and may not be identical across productions. Check the official event information for current offerings and outside-item restrictions.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: All rooms at MARX HALLE are on the ground floor with barrier-free access, and accessible toilets are available. Designated accessible parking bays are directly in front of the hall on Karl-Farkas-Gasse.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Marx Halle's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Marx Halle. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Marx Halle. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
